_comment: Concept/proposal content for Caramelio (Targa, Marrakech) — an unofficial demo website built by Yahya Studio to pitch a premium web presence. This file previews how a future admin dashboard could drive the site. The static HTML pages currently hardcode this same content directly. No claims here are official, no bookings/orders placed through this site are real, and no copyrighted photos are used.
disclaimer: Concept de site web proposé pour Caramelio — non officiel.
